svg.title: Изометрическое разгибание локтя с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One full-body side three-quarter figure only. Static single-arm triceps elbow extension hold against resistance band. One hand holds a clearly visible taut resistance band anchored to a small fixed ring on an upright post above head height in front of body. Upper arm vertical beside torso, elbow almost straight, working fist next to thigh, other arm relaxed and empty. Show complete taut straight band to high anchor and no movement arrows. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
